announce.death: The Minotaur Lord of Minotaur's Rest is dead.

bosses.name: the Behemoth of Hircine's Hunt

announce.spawn: A howl rolls down from the Falkreath pines. Hircine's hunt is abroad tonight.
announce.death: The Behemoth of Hircine's Hunt is dead, and the pack scatters.

bosses._note: Proposed 25 Oct (the Leader for Nat): vanilla's top werewolf boss (EncWerewolf06Boss, Dawnguard's ladder) named and rim-lit; the server's SetScale is a stub, so the boss is its own NPC_ on the Behemoth race (DLE 1D2207, Nat 25 Oct: 1.3x the pack: race 1.30 x NAM6 1.13 = 1.47 against the adds' 1.13). Pack: a werewolf and two wolves at the start, then 3 and 4 more (werewolf, wolf, wolf in turn). Drops: a Werewolf Pelt (Hothtrooper's werewolf fur and leather recipes take it) and three wolf pelts, gold, Silver 5% (the hunter's metal, Hircine's joke), Glass 1%. Every zone is hostile, player werewolves included. fullMoon true (here or in its config block) keeps it to full-moon nights

spots.note: Falkreath: before Bloated Man's Grotto, where Hircine's hunt for Sinding ends (the admin teleport spot)
Falkreath: Glenmoril Coven's door, the witches who bargain with Hircine for the Companions' cure

bosses.name: the Chieftain of Blizzard Rest
bosses._note: Nat 26 Oct: 'We should make a giant boss too', built with the proposal's defaults: Blizzard Rest (BlizzardRestLocation 018EEE), the most remote of the twelve giant camps; a vanilla giant at normal size (a scaled-race Chieftain is a later, separate item); a bull mammoth guards him; mammoths and a giant come in waves. Giants take half damage from magic (npcToughness.giant), so it is a fight for weapons. Schematic: Steel Plate, the heavy plate a giant's strength calls for

announce.spawn: Drums thunder at Blizzard Rest: the giants have a Chieftain.
announce.death: The Chieftain of Blizzard Rest is dead, and his bull with him.

spots.note: Blizzard Rest, the camp's floor south of its chest, cell (9, 9): on navmesh (-8742.5 over terrain -8797), nothing placed within 330 units, 900+ from the camp's wild giant and mammoths
